# @note-systems/sdk

Typed TypeScript client for the Note vault layer on Robinhood Chain: discover vaults, verify them, quote, deposit with partner attribution, track holdings, exit, and deploy a vault under your own mandate.

The package is a thin layer over [viem](https://viem.sh). Reads are batched through Multicall3. Writes simulate first, send with a gas margin, wait for the receipt and read their result from the contract's own events, never from the simulation. Every revert is decoded by name, including errors bubbled from the mandate, the adapter, `NoteCore` and `RollPolicy`.

Contract documentation: [note.systems/docs/build/vaults](https://note.systems/docs/build/vaults). Addresses: [note.systems/docs/developers/addresses](https://note.systems/docs/developers/addresses).

## Install

Releases are published as tarballs at `https://note.systems/sdk/`. `latest.json` there carries the current version, tarball URL and sha512, and every tarball sits next to its `.sha512` file.

```sh
npm install viem https://note.systems/sdk/note-systems-sdk-0.1.2.tgz
```

npm records the tarball's integrity in your lockfile; compare it with `latest.json` before you commit the lock. The package name stays `@note-systems/sdk`, so imports do not change when the registry release follows.

Node 20 or later. `viem` 2.21 or later is a peer dependency.

### Verify a release

```sh
curl -sO https://note.systems/sdk/note-systems-sdk-0.1.2.tgz
curl -s https://note.systems/sdk/note-systems-sdk-0.1.2.tgz.sha512 | sha512sum -c
```

After install, `resolved` and `integrity` for `@note-systems/sdk` in your lockfile must match `latest.json`. Commit the lockfile. To upgrade, install the next tarball URL. At start-up call `factory.codeMatches()` and `vaults.verifyBinding(vault)` and refuse to render a vault that fails either.

## Quick start

```ts
import { createPublicClient, createWalletClient, http } from 'viem';
import { privateKeyToAccount } from 'viem/accounts';
import { NoteError, createNoteClient, partnerId, robinhoodTestnet } from '@note-systems/sdk';

const account = privateKeyToAccount(process.env.PRIVATE_KEY as `0x${string}`);
const publicClient = createPublicClient({ chain: robinhoodTestnet, transport: http() });
const walletClient = createWalletClient({ chain: robinhoodTestnet, transport: http(), account });
const note = createNoteClient({ publicClient, walletClient });

const [vault] = await note.factory.list(0n, 20n);
if (!vault) throw new Error('no vault listed');
if (!(await note.vaults.verifyBinding(vault))) throw new Error('not a bound vault set');

const summary = await note.vaults.summary(vault);
const assets = 100_000_000n; // 100 USDG, six decimals
const shares = await note.vaults.previewDeposit(vault, assets);

await note.vaults.approve(vault, assets);
const deposit = await note.vaults.deposit({ vault, assets, receiver: account.address, partnerId: partnerId('wallet.example') });
console.log(summary.name, shares, deposit.result.shares, deposit.result.tagged, deposit.gasUsed);

try {
  const holding = await note.vaults.holding(vault, account.address);
  await note.vaults.requestRedeem(vault, holding.shares / 2n, account.address, account.address);
} catch (e) {
  if (e instanceof NoteError && e.decoded) console.log(e.decoded.name, e.decoded.message);
  else throw e;
}
```

`examples/partner-integration.ts` walks the same steps end to end against the testnet.

## Client

```ts
createNoteClient({
  publicClient,          // viem PublicClient
  walletClient,          // optional; required for writes
  chainId,               // optional; defaults to publicClient.chain.id
  addresses,             // optional override of the address table (forks)
  gasMarginBps: 3_000,   // added to every gas estimate; default thirty percent
  minGas: 120_000n,      // lower bound on the gas limit sent
});
```

The client checks once that the RPC, the public client, the wallet client and `chainId` all name the same chain and throws `ChainMismatchError` otherwise.

Every vault write accrues the management fee once per block. An estimate taken against a block in which another transaction has already accrued skips that work and comes out low; the mined transaction, landing in a later block, accrues and would run out of gas. Vault writes are therefore estimated twice, plainly and with `lastAccrual` overridden to one second before the latest block so the accrual runs, and the larger figure carries the margin. A node without state override support falls back to the plain estimate.

Gas estimates are taken against the latest block. The mined transaction can do more work than the estimate saw, for example a management fee accrual that the estimate skipped because an earlier transaction in the same block had already accrued, or a queue fill. The margin covers that; it changes the gas limit only, not the fee paid.

## Reads

| Method | Returns |
|---|---|
| `factory.count()`, `factory.list(start, count)` | Vault count and a page of vault addresses |
| `factory.isVault(vault)`, `factory.nextVault()` | Registry lookup, address of the next creation |
| `factory.vaultCodeHash()`, `factory.codeMatches()` | The pinned creation code hash, and whether the bundled code matches it |
| `vaults.summary(vault, { allowUnlisted })` | Name, symbol, asset, share price, idle, locked profit, queue, open series, mandate parameters, `listed` |
| `vaults.verifyBinding(vault)` | True when the factory lists the vault and factory registry, vault, mandate and adapter all point at each other |
| `vaults.bands(vault)`, `vaults.partners(vault)`, `vaults.partner(vault, id)`, `vaults.partnerShares(vault, id)` | Mandate bands, registered partners, shares attributed to a partner id |
| `vaults.previewDeposit`, `previewMint`, `previewRedeem`, `previewWithdraw`, `maxDeposit` | ERC-4626 quotes |
| `vaults.holding(vault, owner)` | Shares, value, partner tag, unlock time, `maxWithdraw`, `maxRedeem`, request count |
| `vaults.requests(vault, owner, start, count)` | Queued redemption requests with `claimable` and `pending` |
| `vaults.exposure(vault)` | Per open series: position, valuation, exposure; `valued: false` when the feed was unavailable |
| `vaults.allowance(vault, owner)` | Quote token allowance to the vault |
| `mandate.executableAt(mandate, data)`, `mandate.owed(mandate, payee)` | Timelock state, deferred fee payments |

`summary` throws `UnlistedVaultError` for an address the factory did not create unless `allowUnlisted` is set. For a listed vault the mandate and adapter come from the factory's registry, not from the vault's own storage.

## Writes

Every write returns `{ hash, receipt, gasUsed, result }`.

| Method | `result` |
|---|---|
| `vaults.approve(vault, assets)` | none |
| `vaults.deposit({ vault, assets, receiver, partnerId? })` | `{ shares, tagged }`, from `Deposit` and `PartnerTagged` |
| `vaults.mint(vault, shares, receiver)` | none |
| `vaults.withdraw(vault, assets, receiver, owner)`, `vaults.redeem(vault, shares, receiver, owner)` | none |
| `vaults.requestRedeem(vault, shares, receiver, owner)` | request id, from `RedeemRequested` |
| `vaults.claimRedeem(vault, id)` | assets paid, from `RedeemClaimed` |
| `vaults.cancelRedeem(vault, id)` | none |
| `vaults.exitInKind(vault, shares, receiver, takeStock = true)` | `{ burned, queued }`, from `ExitedInKind` |
| `vaults.setPartner(vault, id)` | none |
| `vaults.fillQueue(vault)` | number of `RedeemFilled` events |
| `vaults.allocate(vault, seriesId)` | assets allocated, from `Allocated` |
| `vaults.sync(vault)` | `{ actions, bountyPaid }`, from `Realised`, `Settled`, `Harvested` and `BountyPaid` |
| `vaults.realise(vault, seriesId)` | `{ quoteOut, couponOut, fee, stockOut }`, from `Realised` |
| `vaults.collectFees(vault)` | `{ protocol, partners, recipient, bountyPaid }`, from `FeesCollected` and `BountyPaid` |
| `vaults.accrueFees(vault)` | `{ shares, assets }`, from `FeesAccrued` |
| `factory.create(params)` | `{ vault, mandate, adapter }`, from `VaultCreated` |
| `mandate.submit`, `execute`, `revoke` (mandate, data) | none |
| `mandate.tightenLimits`, `lowerFees`, `setMandateDelay`, `disableBand`, `pause`, `unpause`, `claimOwed` | none |

`mandate.encode.setPartner`, `setBand`, `setLimits`, `setFees`, `setBounty` and `setMandateDelay` produce the calldata for the timelocked path; `mandate.actionId(data)` is the id `executableAt` keys on.

`exitInKind` takes breach stock by default, as the contract does; pass `false` when the receiver cannot hold the stock token.

## Validation

`factory.create` runs `validateCreateVaultParams` before anything is sent and throws `ValidationError` with the offending `field`: fee caps (200 and 3,000 bps), partner share cap (5,000 bps), at most 32 distinct partner ids, no zero id or payee, mandate delay between one and thirty days, allocate lead and exit lock between one hour and seven days, bounty caps, at most 16 distinct underlyings. The bounds are exported as `MANDATE_BOUNDS`. The encoders apply the same checks to their arguments.

## Errors

| Class | When |
|---|---|
| `NoteError` | Base class. `decoded` is `{ name, args, selector, message }` for a contract revert and `null` otherwise |
| `TransactionRevertedError` | The transaction was included and reverted. Carries `hash`, `receipt`, `outOfGas` and, when a replay at the previous block reproduces it, `decoded` |
| `ChainMismatchError` | RPC, public client, wallet client or `chainId` disagree |
| `ValidationError` | A parameter fails a bound the contracts enforce |
| `UnlistedVaultError` | `summary` on a vault the factory did not create |

`decodeNoteError(err)` and `decodeRevertData(hex)` are exported for callers who use viem directly. Error messages never contain URLs.

## ABIs and creation code

`NoteVaultAbi`, `NoteVaultMandateAbi`, `NoteVaultFactoryAbi`, `NoteCoreAdapterAbi`, `coreErrorsAbi` and `erc20Abi` are exported as `const` ABIs. `NoteVaultCreationCode` is the creation code the factory pins; `factory.codeMatches()` compares its hash with the factory's before a deployment. Generated files carry the compiler version and a hash of the ABI in their header; `npm run check:abis` fails when they drift from the compiled artifacts, and the test suite pins every hash.

## Development

```sh
npm install
npm run abis        # regenerate src/abi from ../contracts/out (run forge build first)
npm run typecheck   # src, examples and tests
npm test
npm run build
```

`prepack` runs the ABI check, the type check, the tests and the build, so a package cannot be published from a stale or failing tree.
